title: Photoreal Blender recreation of the Somebody Get These Beggars Out of Here meme clip

source_context.shot: Robert Pattinson as Antinous delivers the viral line at the Ithaca banquet
source_context.meme_line: Somebody get these beggars out of here!
reference_clip_candidates: ytsearch1:Somebody get these beggars out of here Robert Pattinson The Odyssey
source_context.reference_use: Download only inside the local worker for tracking, timing, camera matching and local comparison. Never commit or upload the source clip or extracted source frames.

creative_target.fidelity_goal: The rendered clip must be immediately recognizable as the meme clip: same close-up composition, Robert Pattinson likeness, head motion, asymmetrical grin, mouth performance, warm lighting, shallow focus and line timing. It is not a generic banquet shot and not a stylized remake.
priority_order: meme clip timing and facial micro-expression sequence
Robert Pattinson likeness and asymmetrical grin
exact close-up framing and head angle
warm orange-red skin lighting and deep black costume
shallow depth of field with amber circular bokeh
banquet-hall context outside the focal plane

reference_frame.expression: broad asymmetric contemptuous grin with upper teeth visible and one brow slightly raised
reference_frame.costume: near-black ancient tunic or cloak merging into the dark background
reference_frame.lighting: strong warm key from camera-left/front, weak warm rim and nearly black fill
reference_frame.background: dark Ithacan feast hall rendered as soft warm shapes and round fire bokeh

creative_target.final_renderer: Eevee Next for the bounded first animated proof; Cycles may replace it only after the shot and likeness are accepted
creative_target.dialogue: Somebody get these beggars out of here!
creative_target.audio_policy: Use the source audio only for local timing analysis and never redistribute it. The artifact uses a generic Windows synthetic voice and does not clone Robert Pattinson.

reconstruction_pipeline.primary_face_route: YuNet face tracking plus pinned 3DDFA_V2 ONNX dense reconstruction across sampled meme frames, temporally smoothed and imported as Blender morph targets
reconstruction_pipeline.fallback_face_route: Pinned single-frame 3DDFA_V2 reconstruction if sequence download or tracking is blocked
reconstruction_pipeline.appearance_route: Bake a selected sharp reference frame into per-vertex face color. Do not embed the source clip or full source frames in the Blender file.
reconstruction_pipeline.body_route: camera-specific neck, shoulders and black costume built in Blender because only the close-up silhouette is visible
reconstruction_pipeline.hair_route: procedural scalp cap plus groomed curve strands matched to the reference silhouette
reconstruction_pipeline.set_route: minimal physical banquet geometry plus emissive practicals placed to reproduce the reference bokeh
reconstruction_pipeline.camera_route: 85 mm close-up with tracked face framing and a deliberately defocused foreground beggar
reconstruction_pipeline.comparison_route: clean rendered proof frames and machine receipts; user visual review is authoritative for likeness and meme match

worker_policy.source_of_truth: the exact checked-out github.sha on the dedicated branch
